candidate_search.acceptance: both independently materialized canonical_grasp and canonical_carry at the same candidate rank pass every unchanged physical, OOD, camera, companion, contact and runtime gate; first passing rank is frozen
candidate_search.exhaustion: if no rank 1..8 passes both stages, stop R001 before behavioral registration; never expand budget, reorder, loosen thresholds, or select using repair policy behavior
live_materialization_order: Fresh exact E004 s=1 physical reset for every candidate rank and stage; bowl and companions are never written after reset.

Atomically write the full direction-balanced 13-joint vector, including its already-closed six gripper joints, with all joint velocities zero; write the centered cube pose with zero root velocity in the paired historical normal-contact geometry.
Write the same 13-joint vector as the initial joint position target, advance exactly one physics synchronization step with the gripper remaining closed, then read the actual FK EEF pose.
Immediately command a closed-gripper absolute-IK hold at that actual EEF pose for 160 steps. There is no open-gripper step, approach, lift, weld, or artificial constraint.
Canonical_grasp and canonical_carry are independently materialized from their matched-direction paired historical states after separate fresh resets.

Evaluate the final 10 consecutive steps with byte-identical original state_contract physics/OOD functions, original camera/companion code, contact inventory, and exact runtime/source gates. Construction actions and prompts are discarded; policy begins with fresh history.

midpoint_math.cube_orientation: hemisphere-align RIGHT quaternion to LEFT by dot-product sign, normalized arithmetic mean (nlerp t=0.5, wxyz)
midpoint_math.cube_position: coordinatewise arithmetic mean of LEFT and RIGHT cube positions, then set y exactly 0
midpoint_math.cube_to_eef_transform: compute separately in LEFT and RIGHT from source cube/eef poses; translation arithmetic mean and rotation hemisphere-aligned normalized mean
midpoint_math.composed_eef_pose_diagnostic_only: cube pose composed with inverse of the direction-balanced cube-in-EEF transform is retained only as a pre-live construction diagnostic; it is never commanded
midpoint_math.joint_consistency: the full 13-joint midpoint, including closed gripper joints, is written directly; its actual FK pose after one closed physics-sync step defines the fixed closed hold target
midpoint_math.robot_joint_position: coordinatewise arithmetic mean of LEFT and RIGHT 13-joint vectors

pair_eligibility: For a stage, both a LEFT and RIGHT selected source state must exist for the same E004 seed in the frozen OOD provenance.

A canonical_grasp source is any end of three consecutive object_grabbed=true state_capture rows with |cube world y|<0.04 m and cube rise<0.04 m; a canonical_carry source is any later object_grabbed=true row with |cube world y|<0.04 m and cube rise at least 0.04 m. This prospective repair enumeration deliberately retains all qualifying rows rather than the OOD freeze builder's first-only sampling; the OOD metric and acceptance threshold remain unchanged.
Both source OOD distances must pass the unchanged frozen threshold.
The arithmetic midpoint of source cube world y must have absolute value <1 mm.
Each source raw episode, state_capture, HDF5 path, byte count, SHA-256, and exact HDF5 index is bound before live materialization.
pre_live_ranking: For every eligible matched-direction pair compute the direction-balanced joint midpoint and the direction-balanced cube-to-EEF transform.
The preregistered diagnostic anchor is rank 1 per stage: grasp seed 9521 LEFT state 30/HDF5 104 plus RIGHT state 31/HDF5 105; carry seed 9442 LEFT state 39/HDF5 113 plus RIGHT state 38/HDF5 112.

For every other seed choose exactly one within-seed pair by (LEFT/RIGHT arm-joint RMS difference ascending, LEFT/RIGHT EEF position difference ascending, absolute midpoint cube y ascending, LEFT state index ascending, RIGHT state index ascending).

Rank the remaining per-seed pairs by (LEFT/RIGHT arm-joint RMS difference ascending, LEFT/RIGHT EEF position difference ascending, absolute midpoint cube y ascending, maximum source OOD distance ascending, environment_seed ascending).
Candidate rank k pairs grasp-list rank k and carry-list rank k; evaluate ranks 1..8 only in this fixed order. No removal or reorder after any live gate.
candidate_search.provenance_scope: historical E004 pi0.5 behavior generated the frozen source trajectories; R001 candidate construction makes no new model request and is repair-behavior-blind, not provenance-model-blind
candidate_search.purpose: select simulator-valid direction-neutral starting states using only prior E004 state evidence and unchanged gates; never use later repair policy behavior or endpoints
candidate_search.tie_break: environment_seed ascending after all stated continuous ranking keys

failure_diagnosis.engineering_construction_diagnosis: engineering inference: the continuous IK target was derived by mixing the direction-balanced cube-in-EEF transform with the reset cube pose, then immediately reused for carry; it missed normal grasp, disturbed the table/bowl, and never settled

post_candidate_behavioral_design.controller_checkpoint_horizon_scorer_ana: unchanged from original E006 instructions and exact E004 runtime contract
post_candidate_behavioral_design.prompts: existing frozen E004 canonical LEFT/RIGHT only

no mutation of original V3-E006 files
no behavioral queue before accepted state pair
